item.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat BASELINE_DIFF.txt; python3.12 --version; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3.12 -m unittest test_public -v'

/bin/zsh -lc "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3.12 -c 'from solution import TTLCache
checks = 0
def check(condition):
 global checks
 assert condition
 checks += 1
for capacity in (True, False, 0, -1, 1.5, \"2\", None):
 try: TTLCache(capacity, lambda: 0)
 except ValueError: checks += 1
 else: raise AssertionError(capacity)
now = [0]
c = TTLCache(2, lambda: now[0])
c.set(\"a\", None, 2); c.set(\"b\", False, 10)
check(c.get(\"a\") is None)
c.set(\"b\", 0, 10); c.set(\"c\", \"\", 10)
check(c.get(\"a\", \"missing\") == \"missing\")
check(c.get(\"b\") == 0); check(c.get(\"c\") == \"\")
c.set(\"b\", 2, 0); check(c.get(\"b\", \"missing\") == \"missing\")
now[0] = 10; check(len(c) == 0)
for ttl in (True, False, -1, float(\"nan\"), float(\"inf\"), -float(\"inf\"), \"1\", None):
 c = TTLCache(2, lambda: now[0]); c.set(\"a\", 1, 1); c.set(\"b\", 2, 2)
 before = list(c.items.items()); now[0] += 3
 try: c.set(\"a\", 3, ttl)
 except ValueError: pass
 else: raise AssertionError(ttl)
 check(list(c.items.items()) == before)
c = TTLCache(2, lambda: 0); c.set(\"a\", 1, 1); c.set(\"b\", 2, 1)
c.get(\"absent\"); c.set(\"c\", 3, 1); check(c.get(\"a\") is None)
print(f\"{checks} targeted checks passed\")
c = TTLCache(2, lambda: 0.0); c.set(\"a\", \"original\", 10)
try: c.set(\"a\", \"replacement\", 10**1000)
except Exception as exc:
 print(\"Large valid integer TTL:\", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
 print(\"Contents afterward:\", c.items)
else: print(\"Large valid integer TTL accepted\")'"
